li.label: craving coffee
li.description: I need coffee, badly... My head feels foggy, my energy is gone... I'd chew roasted dirt if it smelled remotely like coffee right now.

li.label: desiring coffee
li.description: It's been too long since I had a proper cup of coffee. The day just doesn't feel right without it.

li.label: wanting coffee
li.description: A cup of coffee would be nice. Just something hot and invigorating to get me going.

li.label: content
li.description: Ahh, I've had my coffee. I feel awake and ready to take on the day.

li.label: perfectly brewed
li.description: This was divine. Perfectly brewed coffee, warming my body and sharpening my mind.
